title: Validate the search params and wire them into the loader
acceptanceCriteria: `/posts?page=2&tag=react` renders page 2 of the react posts
A `page` that isn't a positive integer (`abc`, `0`, `-3`, `1.5`) falls back to page 1 instead of erroring
**Next** re-runs the loader and waits for it: page 1 stays on screen with no loading flash until page 2 is ready
**Next** keeps the `tag` in the URL and the list
